articles.title: SCI JCA answer key 2026 released at sci.gov.in: Supreme Court Junior Court Assistant provisional answer key, response sheet and objection link
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India is expected to release the SCI JCA Answer Key 2026 for the Junior Court Assistant recruitment examination on its official website, sci.gov.in. Candidates will be able to download the provisional answer key and response sheet and challenge disputed answers during the tentative objection window ending November 23, 2026, at 11:55 PM..

articles.title: Telangana Police SI hall ticket 2026 released at tgprb.in; 1.6 lakh candidates to appear for November 29 exam: Check direct link to download admit card
articles.summary: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB) has released the Telangana Police SI Hall Ticket 2026 on its official website, tgprb.in. Candidates can download their admit cards using their login credentials.

articles.title: RSSB CET 12th Level City Slip 2026 released at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in: Direct link to download here
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board has issued the RSSB CET 12th Level City Intimation Slip 2026 on November 21. Registered candidates can check their allotted examination districts online through the Rajasthan SSO portal.

articles.title: KPSC KAS prelims result 2026 announced at kpsc.karnataka.gov.in: Direct link to download scorecards here
articles.summary: The Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) is expected to announce the KAS Prelims Result 2026 on its official website. Candidates who appeared for the November 15 examination can check the result date, qualifying status and merit list details.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' day 17: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film outperforms 'KGF: Chapter 2'
articles.summary: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend continues to perform well at the box office on its 17th day. The film earned Rs 27.40 crore net in India, marking a notable increase from the previous day.

articles.title: Ramayana DOP Pankaj Kumar defends Part 2 delay
articles.summary: "Ramayana: Part 2" has been pushed from Diwali 2027 to Diwali 2028 after Part 1's blockbuster run, as the sequel is far bigger in scale. Cinematographer Pankaj Kumar says about 60% is shot, calls the delay positive, and explains the Jatayu-Ravana battle.

articles.title: Anushka Pimputkar calls out edited viral bus video
articles.summary: Anushka Pimputkar criticized the viral edited video that misrepresented a promotional clip for her film Janak. She explained that the original video included important context which was removed before sharing online.

articles.title: Jeff Satur turns to Aamir Khan's '3 Idiots' dialogue to manage anxiety
articles.summary: Jeff Satur has found comfort in the phrase 'All is well' from the movie '3 Idiots'. He applies this phrase as a coping mechanism for his anxiety during difficult situations.
